name: PBK Brain Hypothesis Registry
purpose: Single machine-readable inventory of canonical strategies and research hypotheses. Registry metadata is descriptive/governance-only and never mutates betting eligibility or exposure by itself.
global_guardrails: Historical results are never backfilled into the clean forward journal.
Context and historical patterns are explanatory-only until separately validated.
Probability/value output is separate from canonical strategy authority.
No fabricated probability, xG, xA, lineup, injury, referee or transfer evidence.
Eligibility and execution remain separate layers.
Same fixture/market/selection must not create duplicate exposure.
Quarter Asian handicap lines are not required for final user recommendations; prefer executable half-lines where applicable.
League scope cannot expand beyond config/pbk_competition_scope.json without explicit project-owner decision.

validation_protocol.principle: A visually interesting pattern is evidence to test, not a betting rule.

hypotheses.label: Serie A away unique minimum favourite
hypotheses.definition: Serie A only; away team is unique minimum Bet365 1X2 favourite; 1.20 <= B365A < 2.10; P2; 1u.
guardrails: Do not broaden league scope.
Do not alter odds band through UI filters.

hypotheses.label: Serie A R1 plus last-five PPG advantage
hypotheses.definition: All R1 conditions; both teams have at least 5 previous current-season league matches; away last5 PPG > home last5 PPG; P2; 1u.
guardrails: Do not broaden league scope.
Use only previous matches for last-five form.

hypotheses.label: Big-5 Monday late-season draw
hypotheses.definition: Big-5 only; Monday in local league calendar; both teams have <=10 league matches remaining including current match; X; 1u.
guardrails: Never backfill the historical 155 bets into the clean forward ledger.

hypotheses.label: Historical H2H with home/away orientation
hypotheses.definition: Evaluate same home-team vs same away-team historical meetings separately from reverse venue, including sample size, recency, season spread and deviation from each team's ordinary home/away baseline.
guardrails: Never infer certainty from H2H alone.
Expose sample size and recency.
Compare against team baseline before calling a pattern unusual.

hypotheses.label: Long-horizon team home/away profile
hypotheses.definition: Measure team home and away performance by season and rolling multi-season windows, with opponent-strength/price context where available.
guardrails: Recent seasons and old seasons must remain distinguishable.

hypotheses.label: Weekday and kickoff-time effects
hypotheses.definition: Test weekday and kickoff-time effects without assuming Monday/Thursday or any clock window is universally predictive.
guardrails: Pre-register buckets before evaluating them.

hypotheses.label: Rest days and compressed schedule
hypotheses.definition: Test rest-day differences, midweek load and compressed schedules using only information known before kickoff.
guardrails: No future fixture/result leakage.

hypotheses.label: Domestic cup and European-match load
hypotheses.definition: Test performance after/before domestic cups and UEFA matches, including Thursday/midweek effects, without assigning a universal penalty to any named club.
guardrails: Club-specific examples never become universal rules without evidence.

hypotheses.label: Season stage and objective/consequence context
hypotheses.definition: Measure late-round/table-consequence effects from standings facts, not unverifiable psychology.
guardrails: Only prior finished matches may alter later pre-kickoff context.

hypotheses.label: Favourite and underdog price-band behaviour
hypotheses.definition: Test favourite and underdog outcomes by pre-registered odds bands, including large-price opponents, with ROI and drawdown rather than hit-rate alone.
guardrails: High odds alone are not value.
Do not introduce a global odds cap.

hypotheses.label: Over/under totals hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Develop and validate O/U hypotheses across executable lines instead of ignoring totals.
guardrails: Validate each line/selection separately.

hypotheses.label: BTTS / No-BTTS hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Maintain BTTS research/forward evidence separately from canonical exposure.
guardrails: WATCH never increases canonical exposure.

hypotheses.label: Team-total hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Develop ITB/ITM hypotheses with explicit line, side and price.
guardrails: No recommendation without an executable market line/price.

hypotheses.label: Executable half-line handicap hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Validate half-line handicaps suitable for the user's executable bookmaker constraints.
guardrails: Do not substitute unavailable quarter-lines into final recommendations.

hypotheses.label: Player Overall Grade
hypotheses.definition: Research player-quality grade from strictly pre-kickoff or prior-match evidence.
guardrails: No look-ahead player performance.
Research grade cannot mutate canonical strategy eligibility.

hypotheses.label: Player Importance
hypotheses.definition: Estimate player importance from historical role/usage/quality evidence without inventing missing inputs.
guardrails: Missing evidence remains null/unknown.

hypotheses.label: Starting-XI Quality
hypotheses.definition: Aggregate expected/confirmed XI quality from player grades and importance, preserving expected-vs-confirmed distinction.
guardrails: Confirmed XI must never be backfilled into a timestamp when it was not yet known.

hypotheses.label: Rotation impact
hypotheses.definition: Measure lineup turnover and quality delta versus a pre-match baseline XI/core.
guardrails: Separate ordinary rotation from confirmed absence evidence.

hypotheses.label: Absence and key-player return impact
hypotheses.definition: Test impact of verified absences, unexpected bench/start and returns using player importance and lineup deltas.
guardrails: No transfer/injury/return claim without verified evidence.

hypotheses.label: Referee disciplinary and team-interaction context
hypotheses.definition: Test referee cards, reds, penalties, draws and team-specific history with sample-size and recency controls.
guardrails: Do not label bias from anecdotal or tiny samples.

hypotheses.label: Weather context
hypotheses.definition: Preserve pre-kickoff weather as context and validate predictive value separately.
guardrails: Context alone cannot mutate canonical eligibility.

hypotheses.label: Market movement and closing-line evidence
hypotheses.definition: Measure open/current/closing movement and CLV only when timestamped prices actually exist.
guardrails: CLV remains empty when no closing price exists.

hypotheses.label: Validated probability/value across supported markets
hypotheses.definition: Compare calibrated PBK probability with no-vig market probability and executable price, market by market.
guardrails: Return NO_VALIDATED_MODEL rather than fabricate probability.
High probability is not equivalent to value.

hypotheses.label: Cross-market PBK Decision Engine
hypotheses.definition: Rank independently validated market opportunities using probability, executable value and evidence layers while preserving canonical strategy authority.
guardrails: No automatic canonical promotion.
Explain why, probability/value evidence and minimum acceptable executable price.
